description: This file defines an Android Activity class named Forwarding, which demonstrates how to navigate to another activity and remove itself from the activity back stack to prevent returning to it.

classes.name: Forwarding
classes.description: An Android activity that, upon a button click, forwards the user to another activity and removes itself from the back stack.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and sets up a click listener for the forwarding button.

methods.name: mGoListener
methods.description: Handles the button click event by starting a new activity and finishing the current one to remove it from the activity stack.
